in_sanskrit.name: कस्थूरि
in_sanskrit.meaning: कस्तूरिका, कस्तूरिलोक, सुगन्धिता, विशदा, शोधना, कालरत्न
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is as pure and radiant as saffron, one who is the embodiment of beauty, clarity, and knowledge, a name derived from the saffron color, a name signifying purity and brilliance, a name denoting the sun, a name representing the precious black stone, and a name associated with the Kalaratri form of the Goddess Kali.

in_telugu.name: కస్తూరి

in_marathi.name: Kasthuri
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Saffron in color
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kasthuri हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Kasturi’, Kasthuri is a term used to denote the color saffron. In Hindu mythology, the color represents purity, enlightenment, and wisdom. The term is also associated with the goddess Parvati and the sacred thread worn by Hindu men.
